title: OWNER_PHASE_APPROVAL -- the EXECUTABLE approval record for Gate 1B
description: Gate 1B execution is authorized ONLY by an instance of this schema whose Ed25519 signature verifies under the owner's pinned PUBLIC key. Asymmetric on purpose (review fix): the verifier holds only the public key and CANNOT forge -- unlike an HMAC shared secret. Prose approval is not executable and does not count. A missing or invalid signature fails closed: no job launches. Canonical signing bytes: UTF-8 of json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(',', ':')) with ed25519_signature set to the empty string; no floats may appear except cost_ceiling_usd and per_job_wall_clock_cap_hours, serialized exactly as written by the owner.

package_commit_sha.description: the commit containing the FROZEN Gate 1A package this approval binds to

artifact_digests.description: sha256 per frozen artifact path; MUST equal PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json's sha256 map (the verifier recomputes from the tree); editing any frozen artifact voids the approval

owner_ed25519_public_key_hex.description: the owner's Ed25519 PUBLIC key (32 bytes hex). Pinning law: this value must ALSO be committed by the owner in a separate key-pinning commit before or with the signed record; the verifier refuses if the in-record key differs from the pinned one

ed25519_signature.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes hex) over the canonical signing bytes, made with the owner's PRIVATE key (which never enters this repository or any machine Claude operates)
